messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync for GA clearance: we need a single-page signoff covering SLA, docs/runbook, oncall coverage, monitoring, and billing smoke. Target: green by EOD so deploy can proceed tomorrow.

Rory (SRE): Proposed SLA: hosted default path (rwd-v1) P99 <= 300ms for requests <=512 tokens; availability >= 99.9%. Alerts and a 2-hr watch window post-deploy.

Jun (Eng): Canary passes in staging. I'll add a lightweight prod canary (15m) plus smoke curl to the runbook. Will also include rollback trigger (p99 > 400ms for 10m).

Luca (FinOps): Billing: need quota->rate-card doc and a scripted billing smoke (create org, send 1k tokens, assert invoice.webhook emitted). I can run it if test creds provided.

Rory (SRE): Alert thresholds I suggest:
- perf.p99 > 300ms sustained 5m -> Sev2
- error.rate > 0.8% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 20m -> Exec page
I'll block oncall for first 72h; Jun + I will cover the initial watch.

Jun (Eng): Smoke snippet for runbook:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"smoke"}' | jq .status
Will run against canary and prod as part of deploy checklist.

Ava (PM): Owners: Ava -> final signoff doc & exec ping; Rory -> alerts + oncall rota; Jun -> canary + runbook + rollback steps; Luca -> billing mapping + smoke validation. Please :thumbsup: to accept.

Luca (FinOps): :thumbsup: test creds incoming. I will post invoice sample and webhook payload here after run.

Rory (SRE): :thumbsup: scheduling 2-hr watch window and 72h coverage.

Jun (Eng): :thumbsup: ETA docs update 3hrs.

OpsBot: Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/ga-launch-compact (canary + rollback checklist attached).

Ava (PM): Thanks all  if no objections by 18:00 PT I'll mark signoff and schedule the deploy.
